description: Search Amazon for Mother's Day / Mors dag gift ideas on the user's marketplace. Returns PA-API products when configured for the default storefront, otherwise Mother's Day search deep-link cards + catalogMatches. Pass marketplace + locale for the end user (marketplace=amazon.com for US/English, amazon.se for Sweden; if omitted, Accept-Language en-US → amazon.com, else amazon.se). OpenAPI: searchAmazon.

locale.description: User locale, e.g. en, sv, de, fr, es (mothers day / mors dag / Muttertag / fête des mères / día de la madre)

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront for the end user, e.g. amazon.se, amazon.com, us, se, de. Recommended: pass marketplace=amazon.com for US shoppers (US catalog, English, USD, tag sw-mothersday-20) and amazon.se for Sweden (SE catalog, tag sw-mothersday-21). If omitted: Accept-Language en-US → amazon.com, otherwise amazon.se. Other storefronts get Mother's Day search links.

q.description: Search query, e.g. spa set, pearl earrings

name: search_gifts
title: Search Mother's Day gifts
